provenance.inputs_summary: backend/amcrax/data/kinetics.yaml validity fields; research/notes/*; results/research/validation/kinetics.json statuses

rule:
Every catalyst rate law in backend/amcrax/data/kinetics.yaml and every catalyst named by the author is given exactly
one class at the AmCraX conditions (20 bar; study temperatures 450-700 degC; operating points 499-594 degC):

amcrax_conditions.note: standalone and integrated studies at 20 bar (pressure studies 1.013-40 bar); operating points = lowest T for 95 % conversion with 100 kg catalyst per 100 kmol/h NH3 (results/research/aspen_kinetic/catalyst_comparison.json)

statement: No AmCraX kinetic law is validated at 20 bar. Every kinetic result at 20 bar is a pressure extrapolation; Takahashi laws are additionally unvalidated at 1 atm (failed figure predictions).

laws.law_form: microkinetic, 4 lumped elementary steps, QSS coverages (Eqs. 5-14); mole-fraction basis p_i/p_total
laws.fitted_range_basis: fit 350-450 degC (<20 % conversion), extrapolation tests by the authors 500-650 degC; all 1 atm

experimental.feed: NH3 0.1-1.0 atm in Ar; H2 co-feed 0-0.7 atm at p_NH3 0.3 atm
experimental.space_velocity: SV 15000-30000 h-1 (fit), 2000-20000 h-1 (tests); basis of SV and catalyst mass not reported

laws.h2_inhibition: fitted (H2 re-adsorption step 4, k-4 = k4/K4; Fig. 5 data)
laws.reversibility: not in the published law (steps 2, 3 irreversible); AmCraX approach factor (1 - Q/Kp) is an assumption

literature_comparisons.what: PFR conversion vs Figs. 3a/3b/5a (read from figures; W/F from one anchor point)

numerical_checks: EXISTING-KIN-TABLE2 pass (Table 1 vs Table 2 at 773 K, 6.8 % < 10 %)
KINR-ASPENAPPROX-ni pass (fitted Aspen LHHW approximation vs exact law, 0.034 < 0.05)
laws.aspen_representation: fitted LHHW approximation (python fit, mole-fraction basis, 20 bar only); not native
laws.class_evidence: no passing comparison with published data (EXISTING-KIN-NI-PRED fail 0.1096 > 0.05); fitted at 1 atm
